title: Science Academies' Summer Research Fellowship Programme for Students and Teachers 2027
institution: Indian Academy of Sciences, Indian National Science Academy and The National Academy of Sciences, India (IAS-INSA-NASI)

compensation.value: Round-trip train fare and a monthly fellowship stipend
compensation.evidence_quote: round-trip train fare and a monthly fellowship stipend

about: India's three science academies offer two-month summer research fellowships with an assigned guide for students and teachers at Indian institutions. Online applications for 2027 close on 30 November 2026; selection notices are expected around March-April 2027.
requirements: Students or teachers at institutions in India
Teachers who have already received the fellowship twice cannot apply
Two months with an assigned guide, preferably in summer

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Research" (record skills) / "Science and engineering research" (record field) → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"Two months with an assigned guide, preferably in summer" (record qualifications) → "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management."
